name: checkbox
blurb: Basic checkbox with checked, indeterminate, and disabled states.
description: Radix UI Checkbox wrapper with built-in states for checked, indeterminate, and disabled. Shows check mark or dash indicator. Includes focus ring and error states via aria-invalid.
use_when: Simple boolean toggles in forms, lists, or settings.
avoid_when: Radio groups—use radio buttons for mutually-exclusive options.
a11y: Full keyboard support via Radix UI. Focus-visible ring. aria-invalid for error states. Indeterminate state support.
